edit_prompt:
General Intent: Edit the image to evoke disgust by adding masses of decaying marine life.

Detailed Steps:
1. Add large quantities of dead fish, some bloated and pale, washed up on the shore, concentrated in a thick line along the tide mark and clustered around the base of the boat.
2. Add several dead seagulls and other seabirds entangled in discarded fishing nets and plastic six-pack rings, scattered across the sand.
3. Add clumps of slimy, dark green and brown seaweed mixed with the dead fish to enhance the sense of decay. Keep the edits realistic.
